description: Record what happened to your resident's daily morning task in this app: set (you made it), changed (you moved its hour), stopped (the person asked to stop it, and you removed it) or couldnt (the app couldn't set it). Call it right after. It sets, changes and removes no task itself: the app does that. It returns the prompt the task uses. After stopped, Plazmi doesn't bring the task up again; only the person can.

hour.description: Optional: the hour it runs, on the person's clock, like 8. Left out, 8.

state.description: What happened: set, changed, stopped or couldnt.

name: morning_task
title: Morning task
